properties.note: Mason County's 21 voting precincts. The geometry is the Census 2020 voting-district fabric, which sums to the county's exact 2020 population of 13,086; the names are the county's own, taken from its certified returns and identical in the 2024 General (ISBE election 66) and the 2026 General Primary (ISBE election 69). Mason County's two board districts are unions of whole townships and ship as their own layer, so no board district is carried here. No polling place is carried, and no roster.
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts under Mason County's own precinct names, as its certified returns spell them
